proposal.quote: the obstacle which the Rhineland reoccupation constituted vis-à-vis Franco-German discussion
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the dispatch refers to the Rhineland reoccupation as an accomplished fact standing in the way of Franco-German talks.

proposal.quote: the recognition of Austria’s independence and separate existence was demanded by the Chancellor and secured as an indispensable preliminary
proposal.rule: claude backend: Annexation requires German troops in Austria and a reunification law; instead Germany is reported as recognizing Austria's independence, so the level remains independent.

proposal.quote: the concentration of attention on international affairs following the Rhineland occupation
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the dispatch refers to the German Rhineland occupation as an accomplished fact predating its date.

proposal.quote: then the reoccupation of the demilitarized zone in the Rhineland
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone, and the passage reports the reoccupation of the demilitarized zone as an accomplished German move as of the document's date.

proposal.quote: the French Government intended to make every possible effort to work out with the four other Locarno powers the settlement of questions between them which will permit the establishment of peace in Europe on a sound and lasting basis
proposal.rule: claude backend: Limited: Paris, after the London three-power meeting, treats German aims as open to a negotiated general settlement among the five Locarno powers; the statement is reported by an under-secretary, not drawn from Cabinet records.

proposal.quote: work out with the four other Locarno powers the settlement of questions between them
proposal.rule: claude backend: Appease: Western policy as reported seeks a general settlement through a five-power Locarno meeting, with no new commitment to fight for a third state mentioned.

proposal.quote: at recent London conversations his Government had patently shown its desire for an opportunity to get Germany to the conference table and to give real consideration to her ideas
proposal.rule: claude backend: Limited: the governments are reported as still pursuing a negotiated Locarno settlement with Germany (the conference and the questionnaire), but this is second-hand embassy reporting, not Cabinet records.

proposal.quote: Very strained relations developing between Italy and Germany on one side and French on the other side.
proposal.rule: claude backend: italy_estranged is true while Italy is estranged from the West; the ambassador reports strained Italian-French relations, consistent with continued estrangement, though the cause here is Spain rather than Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: the French Government had not wished to put any obstacles in the way of the possibility of coming to some reasonable arrangement with Hitler
proposal.rule: claude backend: limited: the French Foreign Minister describes Paris's policy at the London tripartite meeting and the projected Five Power Locarno conference as seeking a negotiated arrangement with Hitler, treating German aims as open to settlement.

proposal.quote: our Neutrality Law with respect to embargo of arms, ammunition, and implements of war has no application in the present situation, since that applies only in the event of war between or among nations
proposal.rule: claude backend: The isolationist level is the Neutrality Act regime with a mandatory arms embargo on belligerents, and the Acting Secretary refers to that embargo law as in force for wars between nations.

proposal.quote: our neutrality laws and to the fact that they have no application in the present Spanish situation, since they apply only in the event of war between or among nations
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means the Neutrality Act regime is in force. The State Department cites the neutrality laws as standing law for wars between nations and discourages aircraft sales even where they do not legally apply, which is consistent with that regime.

proposal.quote: Germany felt capable of throwing off the last of the Versailles military servitudes and marched into the demilitarized zone in the Rhineland
proposal.rule: claude backend: remilitarized means German troops in the zone; the despatch reports Germany marched into the demilitarized zone (no exact date given, so the document date is used).

proposal.quote: marched into the demilitarized zone in the Rhineland... this step, materially unopposed by France
proposal.rule: claude backend: dead requires the zone reoccupied and the guarantors declining enforcement; the despatch reports the reoccupation went materially unopposed by France.

proposal.quote: culminated in the military reoccupation of the Rhineland on March 7, 1936
proposal.rule: claude backend: remilitarized: German troops garrisoned in the zone from 7 Mar 1936; the memo states the military reoccupation outright as a past event.

proposal.quote: With that action Germany had thrown off all of the shackles of the Treaty of Versailles ... Europe was content to permit Germany to take action within her frontiers
proposal.rule: claude backend: dead: the zone has been reoccupied and the passage indicates the guarantors acquiesced rather than enforcing, though it does not cite the formal Locarno-power decision of 19 Mar 1936.

proposal.quote: Two years ago many observers would have been inclined to answer these queries in the affirmative. ... the reestablishment of universal military service and the remilitarization of the Rhineland were dreams yet to be realized.
proposal.rule: claude backend: remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the ambassador says remilitarization was only a dream two years earlier, which implies it has since happened, but he does not state outright that troops are garrisoned there.

proposal.quote: the reestablishment of universal military service and the remilitarization of the Rhineland were dreams yet to be realized. But the situation has changed since then
proposal.rule: claude backend: remilitarized applies when German troops are garrisoned in the zone; the despatch says the remilitarization, a dream two years earlier, has since been realized.

proposal.quote: Forces in the Rhineland, former demilitarized zone, will be raised to 6 divisions or 70,000 men which is double the garrison established there last March.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the passage reports an existing German garrison in the former demilitarized zone since March.

proposal.quote: There is as yet, however, no conclusive evidence of a definite German-Italian tie-up.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The axis flag requires the Rome-Berlin alignment (October Protocols); the ambassador reports that no definite German-Italian tie-up exists yet, despite military discussions.

proposal.quote: Italy could not in view of the seating of the Ethiopian delegation make any gesture at this time towards the European collaboration required by the treaty.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy remains estranged from the West over Ethiopia: Ciano refuses European collaboration because of the League's seating of the Ethiopian delegation and cites British naval moves in the Mediterranean.
